```{=html}
<input type="text" id="table-filter" class="form-control form-control-sm mb-3"
       placeholder="Filter by title, director, category…"
       oninput="filterTable()">
<script>
function filterTable() {
  var q = document.getElementById('table-filter').value.toLowerCase();
  document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr').forEach(function(r) {
    r.style.display = r.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q) ? '' : 'none';
  });
}
</script>
```
